title: The Monolith paid three and untapped for one
deckReference: Power Artifact — Basalt Monolith study deck
era: 2000-era casual Type I card pool using 2006+ Oracle rules

story: My Basalt Monolith had been in play since the previous turn when I tapped two Island s to cast Power Artifact on it. The Aura resolved. I tapped Monolith for three colorless mana, spent one to activate its discounted untap ability, and kept two floating. I untapped Monolith and tapped it for three more. Repeating that exchange could build as much colorless mana as I needed, but Stroke of Genius would still require blue mana from another source. I watched my opponent's untapped Underground Sea : removing the Aura at the right moment could leave the Monolith unable to continue.
